name: n8n_manage_datatable
description: Manage n8n data tables and rows. Actions: createTable, listTables, getTable, updateTable, deleteTable, getRows, insertRows, updateRows, upsertRows, deleteRows.

tableId.description: Data table ID (required for all actions except createTable and listTables)

name.description: For createTable: table name. For updateTable: new name (rename only — schema is immutable after creation)

columns.description: For createTable (required, at least one): column definitions. Schema is immutable after creation via public API.

data.description: For insertRows: array of row objects. For updateRows/upsertRows: object with column values.

search.description: For getRows: text search across string columns

returnType.description: For insertRows: what to return (default: count)

returnData.description: For updateRows/upsertRows/deleteRows: return affected rows (default: false)

dryRun.description: For updateRows/upsertRows/deleteRows: preview without applying (default: false)

projectId.description: For createTable: project ID to create the table in. If omitted, uses the default project.
